summary: Ukrainian forces struck the Borisoglebsk airbase in Russia's Voronezh region with Neptune missiles, destroying six Su-34 bombers and causing a massive fire. Russia launched a massive overnight drone and missile barrage across at least ten Ukrainian regions, killing at least nine civilians in Lutsk and Kirovohrad. Ukrainian troops liberated 101 km² of territory and inflicted approximately 3,000 Russian casualties while securing the Kharkiv-Slovyansk supply route.
key_points: Ukrainian Neptune missiles destroyed six Su-34 bombers at Borisoglebsk airbase in Voronezh region, causing a massive fire. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76944)

Russia conducted a massive overnight attack with Geran-5 missiles and reactive Shahed drones targeting Kyiv, Rivne, Lutsk, Poltava, Kirovohrad, Odesa, Mykolaiv, Chernihiv, Zhytomyr, Vinnytsia, and Cherkasy regions. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76942)
Six civilians killed and 12 injured, including a child, in Lutsk from Geran-5 missile impacts. (Source: @UkraineNow/84658)
Kirovohrad region endured over 10 hours of massive drone attacks with three dead, six injured, and 25 strike locations recorded. (Source: @UkraineNow/84667)
Ukrainian forces liberated 101 km² of territory, inflicted ~3,000 Russian casualties, and prevented Russian forces from cutting the Kharkiv-Slovyansk highway. (Source: @UkraineNow/84654)
Ukrainian strikes hit Russian drone launch sites and ammunition depots in occupied Donetsk region near Donetsk, Popova Balka, and Hirnyk. (Source: @UkraineNow/84656)
President Zelensky announced Ukraine will resume strikes on Russian oil refineries after a three-day pause, citing over 100 civilian deaths in the past week. (Source: @UkraineNow/84666)
Starlink/StarShield military terminal restrictions disrupted Ukrainian military missions overnight without prior warning. (Source: @UkraineNow/84659)

sections.executive_summary: Ukrainian Neptune missiles struck the Borisoglebsk airbase in Russia's Voronezh region, destroying six Su-34 bombers and igniting a massive fire at a key base for aircraft dropping glide bombs on Ukraine. Russia responded with a massive overnight drone and missile barrage across at least ten Ukrainian regions, killing nine civilians in Lutsk and Kirovohrad and triggering prolonged air alerts in Kyiv. Meanwhile, Ukrainian forces liberated 101 km² of territory, inflicted approximately 3,000 Russian casualties, and secured the strategic Kharkiv-Slovyansk supply route.

points: Ukrainian forces launched Neptune cruise missiles at the Borisoglebsk military airfield in Voronezh region, destroying six Su-34 fighter-bombers and causing a massive fire; the base hosts Su-34, Su-35S, and Su-30SM aircraft used to launch glide bombs against Ukraine. (Source: @UkraineNow/84664, @UkraineNow/84670, @mon1tor_ua/76944)

Ukrainian defense forces struck Russian drone launch sites and ammunition depots in occupied Donetsk region, targeting a storage and launch facility near Donetsk and supply depots near Popova Balka and Hirnyk. (Source: @UkraineNow/84656)
Ukrainian FPV drone operators destroyed a modernized Russian Mi-28 attack helicopter along with its crew in an unspecified frontline sector. (Source: @UkraineNow/84655)
Ukrainian drones attacked a Sberbank data center in Balakovo, Saratov region, causing multiple explosions and fires confirmed by satellite imagery. (Source: @UkraineNow/84657)

President Zelensky confirmed Ukraine will resume strikes on Russian oil refineries after a three-day pause, stating Russia killed over 100 civilians in the past week while Ukraine halted energy infrastructure attacks. (Source: @UkraineNow/84666)

Starlink/StarShield military satellite terminals experienced restricted functionality overnight, disrupting several important Ukrainian military missions without prior notification. (Source: @UkraineNow/84659)

Russian forces launched a massive overnight barrage of Geran-5 missiles and reactive Shahed-type drones from multiple directions: Bryansk region toward Chernihiv, Black Sea toward Mykolaiv and Odesa, occupied Zaporizhzhia toward Kherson, and from northern, eastern, and southern Ukrainian regions toward central and western targets. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76942, @mon1tor_ua/76941, @kpszsu/86863, @kpszsu/86869)
Russian tactical aviation launched guided aerial bombs (KABs) against Zaporizhzhia region. (Source: @kpszsu/86867)

Geran-5 missiles struck Lutsk, killing six civilians and injuring 12 including a child; multiple impacts reported in Rivne and Kirovohrad regions. (Source: @UkraineNow/84658, @mon1tor_ua/76947, @UkraineNow/84667)

Drone debris fell in Kyiv's Pecherskyi district near a residential building, injuring five people, damaging facades and windows of two apartment buildings, and setting a car on fire. (Source: @UkraineNow/84671)
FBI Director Kash Patel arrived in Russia for unknown purposes; details and objectives not disclosed. (Source: @UkraineNow/84662, @UkraineNow/84660)

Ukrainian forces liberated 101 km² of territory in the eastern sector, inflicted approximately 3,000 Russian casualties, and prevented Russian forces from severing the strategic Kharkiv-Slovyansk highway. (Source: @UkraineNow/84654)
Ukrainian strikes targeted Russian drone launch and storage facilities near Donetsk city and ammunition depots near Popova Balka and Hirnyk in occupied Donetsk region. (Source: @UkraineNow/84656)
Russian guided aerial bombs (KABs) were launched by tactical aviation against Zaporizhzhia region. (Source: @kpszsu/86867)
A reactive Shahed drone was observed circling over Donetsk region before heading toward Dnipropetrovsk region's Pavlohrad district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76941)

Multiple Geran-5 missiles launched from Bryansk region (Russia) flew toward Chernihiv region's Chernihiv district; reactive Shahed drones entered Chernihiv region from Belarus border area moving toward Kyiv region. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76942, @kpszsu/86856, @eRadarrua/123137)
Reactive Shahed drones transited Chernihiv region past Slavutych toward Kyiv region; additional drones detected near Horodnya. (Source: @eRadarrua/123222, @kpszsu/86864)

Kyiv region experienced multiple air alerts; Geran-5 missiles approached from Chernihiv region toward Vyshhorod district, and a reactive Shahed flew past Chornobyl exclusion zone westward. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76942, @kpszsu/86858, @eRadarrua/123141)

Reactive drones detected over Zhytomyr region near Ovruch, Irshansk, Brusyliv, and Olevsk moving toward Rivne region; air alerts active in Kyiv, Zhytomyr, Chernihiv, and Sumy regions. (Source: @kpszsu/86862, @eRadarrua/123132, @eRadarrua/123142)

Reactive Shahed drones launched from Black Sea waters targeted Mykolaiv region's Mykolaiv district and Odesa region; additional drones approached from occupied Kherson region toward Mykolaiv and from occupied Zaporizhzhia toward Kherson. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76941, @kpszsu/86863, @kpszsu/86869, @kpszsu/86876)
Odesa region detected reactive drones moving toward Zatoka from Black Sea; a drone also approached Chornomorsk. (Source: @kpszsu/86869, @mon1tor_ua/76951)

Reactive Shahed drones transited from Mykolaiv region toward Kirovohrad region's Kropyvnytskyi district; from Odesa region toward Vinnytsia region's Haisyn district. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76941, @mon1tor_ua/76951)
Kirovohrad region endured over 10 hours of massive drone attacks with 25 strike locations, three dead, six injured, and residential damage reported. (Source: @UkraineNow/84667)

Ukrainian Neptune missiles struck Borisoglebsk airbase in Voronezh region, destroying six Su-34 bombers and causing a massive fire at a base hosting Su-34, Su-35S, and Su-30SM aircraft used for glide bomb attacks. (Source: @UkraineNow/84664, @UkraineNow/84670, @mon1tor_ua/76944)

Russia launched a massive coordinated overnight attack using Geran-5 missiles and reactive Shahed drones from at least six launch axes: Bryansk region, Black Sea, occupied Zaporizhzhia, occupied Kherson, northern Ukraine, and eastern Ukraine, targeting 11+ Ukrainian regions simultaneously. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76942, @mon1tor_ua/76941, @kpszsu/86847, @kpszsu/86871)

Kyiv experienced two separate air alerts (07:59 and 08:24) with drone threats; alerts lifted at 08:04 and 10:10; drone debris caused casualties and damage in Pecherskyi district. (Source: @eRadarrua/123144, @eRadarrua/123150, @eRadarrua/123146, @eRadarrua/123213, @UkraineNow/84671)

Reactive Shahed drones penetrated deep into western Ukraine: detected over Rivne region toward Kostopil and Lutsk (153 km away), over Zhytomyr region toward Rivne, over Khmelnytskyi region, and over Vinnytsia region toward Zhmerynka and Ladyzhyn. (Source: @kpszsu/86849, @mon1tor_ua/76943, @kpszsu/86865, @eRadarrua/123135, @kpszsu/86880)
Ukrainian air defenses engaged targets across multiple regions; monitoring channels reported numerous intercepts but specific shoot-down numbers not provided in source messages.

Massive Russian overnight barrage of Geran-5 missiles and reactive Shaheds struck 11+ Ukrainian regions from six launch axes, killing nine civilians in Lutsk and Kirovohrad. (Source: @mon1tor_ua/76942)
Ukrainian forces liberated 101 km² in eastern sector, inflicted ~3,000 Russian casualties, and secured Kharkiv-Slovyansk supply route. (Source: @UkraineNow/84654)
Zelensky announced resumption of strikes on Russian refineries after three-day pause, citing 100+ civilian deaths from continued Russian attacks. (Source: @UkraineNow/84666)
Starlink/StarShield military terminal restrictions disrupted Ukrainian missions overnight without warning. (Source: @UkraineNow/84659)
Ukrainian strikes hit Russian drone launch sites and ammo depots in occupied Donetsk near Donetsk, Popova Balka, and Hirnyk. (Source: @UkraineNow/84656)
FBI Director Kash Patel arrived in Russia for undisclosed purposes. (Source: @UkraineNow/84662)
sections.threat_assessment: The Ukrainian strike on Borisoglebsk airbase demonstrates growing long-range precision strike capability against high-value Russian aviation assets, potentially degrading glide bomb campaigns. Russia's massive multi-axis drone/missile barrage indicates sustained capacity for large-scale terror strikes on civilian infrastructure across Ukraine's depth. The simultaneous Starlink/StarShield restrictions during the attack suggest possible coordination or exploitation of communications vulnerabilities. Ukrainian territorial gains near Kharkiv and strikes on Donetsk logistics show continued offensive pressure despite Russian air superiority.
sections.regional_response: Ukraine's allies are expected to announce new military and energy aid packages following President Zelensky's London talks, though specifics remain undisclosed. The FBI Director's unannounced visit to Russia raises questions about potential backchannel communications or intelligence exchanges amid the conflict. Portugal's national team promotion of Chinese automaker Changan, which supplies vehicles to Russian forces, highlights ongoing sanctions evasion challenges. Regional air defense coordination remains critical as Russian drones penetrate deep into western Ukraine.
sections.intelligence_notes: The high density of reactive Shahed drones transiting Chernihiv and Kyiv regions toward western Ukraine suggests Russia is testing new routing to bypass air defenses. Monitoring channels report Geran-5 missiles comprising 85% of launches from Belarus direction, indicating reliance on northern launch corridors. The Borisoglebsk strike used Neptune missiles, confirming Ukrainian naval missile adaptation for land-attack roles. Starlink restrictions affected military-grade StarShield terminals specifically, implying targeted degradation of command and control during the Russian barrage.
